content.summary: Bounded execution contract for assessing security posture against selected security blocks and threat models.
acceptanceCriteria: Every selected security-domain block is assessed.
Every finding references a specific block, acceptance criterion, or constraint.
No fabricated vulnerabilities — all findings traceable to block evidence or constraint violations.
Threat surface summary derived from block failureModes, not generic lists.
Output severity levels match block gapSignal severity definitions.
invariants: All findings must always trace back to specific block evidence or constraint violations.
Output severity levels must always match the defined gap signal severity definitions.
mustNot: Do not fabricate vulnerabilities not supported by codebase evidence.
Do not produce generic findings not grounded in specific blocks.
failureModes: Fabricating vulnerabilities not supported by codebase evidence — false positive threats.
Missing critical attack surfaces covered by selected security blocks — false negative assessment.
Reporting only obvious issues while missing subtle constraint violations.
Producing generic OWASP list instead of project-specific findings grounded in blocks.
